findings.current: Compressed air exploded beneath my feet, launching me at terrifying speed toward its plummeting figure.
findings.defect: The source describes the sound of compressed air bursting accompanying the launch; it does not establish an actual explosion beneath the narrator's feet or make that explosion the launch mechanism.
findings.rationale: The Korean uses 압축된 공기가 터져나가는 소리와 함께, explicitly framing this as a sound, then separately states that the narrator shot toward the Arch Lich.
findings.replacement: With the sound of compressed air bursting, I shot toward the Arch Lich’s rapidly falling body at terrifying speed.

findings.current: Before my all-out Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist could connect, it had covered its face with a Bone Shield.
findings.defect: The explicit causal purpose of the Bone Shield—protecting itself—is omitted.
findings.rationale: 스스로를 보호했다 directly states that the Arch Lich overlaid the shield in order to protect itself; the current line only describes the physical action.
findings.replacement: Before my all-out Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist could connect, it had covered its face with a Bone Shield to protect itself.

findings.current: The next instant, its hand of dark, weathered bone clawed through the air.
findings.defect: “Weathered bone” changes 거무튀튀한 뼈마디 into aged or eroded bone and drops the source's physical detail of segmented bone joints.
findings.rationale: 거무튀튀한 describes a dull, dingy darkness, while 뼈마디 specifies the jointed or segmented bone structure forming the hand.
findings.replacement: The next instant, its hand, made of dark, dingy bone segments, clawed through the air.

findings.current: That spear in your chest looks good on you. Want me to plant another one?
findings.defect: “Looks good on you” shifts the joke from calling the spear itself pretty to saying that the spear suits the Arch Lich, changing the source's deadpan object-focused taunt.
findings.rationale: 가슴에 박힌 창, 예쁘네 directly calls the spear pretty; the follow-up offers to add another spear, preserving the blunt joke about the weapon rather than its suitability to the wearer.
findings.replacement: That spear stuck in your chest is pretty. Want me to plant another one?

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, but a few mastered lines add or lose source-specific physical, causal, or joke detail.
